text: Quick recap. Birth and death rates are per thousand people, but infant mortality is per thousand live births. Doubling time is about seventy over the growth rate: seventy five years for Nepal today. Pyramids show growth, and Nepal is late in the demographic transition. In malaria, the mosquito is the definitive host. H I V destroys helper T cells. And non communicable diseases now cause most deaths.
